notes: milenio.com (Mexico) is CMI/Arc-free: robots.txt allows our bot and declares /sitemap/sitemap-articles-index.xml, whose monthly files are /sitemap/articles/sitemap-articles-{YYYY}-{MM}.xml BUT the running month has no such file (generic 403 not-found) - the current month lives only in the rolling sitemap-articles-current.xml, which holds the last ~25 days (09-30 4 URLs + 2026-10-01..10-25 at 236-586 URLs/day, lastmod = publication time). So the window 2026-09-25..2026-10-25 is covered by two LITERAL templates: articles-current.xml for October, sitemap-articles-2026-09.xml for September (602 URLs on 09-30, 494 on 09-25). No per-day sitemap (sitemap-articles-YYYY-MM-DD.xml 403) and no dated HTML archive (/archivo and /hemeroteca 404).
